sentences.text:
This appeal by the appellant/claimant under section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act is arising out of the award dated 09.08.2021 passed by 1st Additional Member, MACT, Jaora, District Ratlam in Claim Case No.19/2016.
2.
The date of accident, death of the deceased, negligence and the issue of liability is not in dispute.
The findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal in this regard are not in dispute.
As per the findings of the Tribunal in this, the death of the deceased is proved due to the said accident.
Hence, the Tribunal has awarded a total compensation of Rs.5,93,286/- along with interest.

3. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the Tribunal has committed an error in not awarding just and proper amount of compensation in the case as the amount awarded by the Tribunal is on the lower side.

At the very outset, counsel for the appellant submits that the income and future prospects of the award is not improper, but the learned trial Court has committed error of law in not calculating the dependency as 1/2 and since the wife is alive, it should be 1/3.

Hence,
prays for just and proper amount of compensation in the matter.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:9747 2 MA-2344-2022 4.

On the other hand, learned counsel for the Insurance Company contends that the Claims Tribunal has rightly awarded the amount of compensation in the matter which does not call for any Smt. Pukhraj vs Satyanarayan on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102035840/
1 interference by this Court.

sentences.text: However, he has admitted that the loss of dependency should be 1/3 in place 1/2 since the wife of the deceased is alive.
5. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of the record and looking to the limited prayer of counsel for the parties.
Therefore, in the considered opinion of this Court, the amount of compensation deserves to be enhanced and the same is enhanced as under:

Heads Amount (Awarded by Tribunal) Enhanced by this Court Income :7500+(10%)-1/2x12x9 :7500+(10%)-1/3x12x9 =Rs.4,45,500/- =Rs.5,94,000/-
 Conveyance/ :Rs.25,000/- 
 Medical Expense: :Rs.1786/- 
 Loss of Consortium : Rs.88,000/-

Funeral Expenses :Rs.16,500/- 
 .Loss of Estate :Rs.16,500/-

Total : Rs.5,93,286/- 
 MACT Award :Rs.5,93,286/-
 Enhanced amount :Rs.7,41,786-Rs.5,
 =Rs.1,48,500 6.
Thus, the just and proper amount of compensation in the instant case is Rs.7,41,786/- as against the Award of the Claims Tribunal of Rs.5,93,286/-.
Accordingly, the appellant/claimant are entitled to an additional sum of (Rs.7,41,786-5,93,286) = Rs.1,48,500/- over and above the amount, which has been awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
7. In the result, this miscellaneous appeal is partly allowed.
The claimants are entitled to NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:9747 3 MA-2344-2022 get total amount of compensation i.e. Rs.5,93,286/- + Rs.1,48,500/- =7,41,786/-.
The enhanced amount i.e. Rs.31,48,500/- shall carry interest as fixed by the learned Claims Tribunal from the date of filing of claim petition till its realization.
The said amount be paid within a period of three months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
Rest of conditions as imposed by learned Claims Tribunal shall remain intact.

8. If the enhanced amount of compensation is in excess to the valuation of appeal, the difference of the Court fee (if not already paid) shall be deposited by the appellants- Smt. Pukhraj vs Satyanarayan on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102035840/
2 claimants within a period of one month and proof thereof, shall be submitted before the Registry.
Thereafter, the Registry shall issue the certified copy of the order passed today.
9. In view of above, miscellaneous appeal filed by the appellants- claimants stands disposed of.
With the aforesaid, appeal stands disposed off.
(PREM NARAYAN SINGH) JUDGE amit Smt. Pukhraj vs Satyanarayan on 9 April, 2025
